spec.name: Halloween Apple Bobbing Barrel
spec.description: Open oak bobbing barrel with a stepped round silhouette, thick wooden rim, copper bands and still blue water. Fits within one block with its base at y=0. No apples, text, bones or animations.

prompt: Open round oak apple-bobbing barrel full of blue water with copper bands. NO apples; animated apples added by the game. Fits 0..16 all axes, base y=0. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
